routing:
Plain text description of routes:
- Public: / (Home), /collections/unstitched (Unstitched Fabrics), /collections/ready-to-wear (Pret), /collections/men-and-kids (Men & Kids), /collections/home-and-fragrances (Home & Fragrances), /sale (Seasonal Sale), /track-order (Track Order), /login, /signup, /product/:id (Product Detail with 3D)
- User Area (requires Customer guard): /account/dashboard, /account/orders, /account/wishlist, /account/rewards
- Admin Area (requires Admin/Manager guard): /admin/dashboard, /admin/products, /admin/orders, /admin/inventory, /admin/discounts
notes: Store API includes: getProducts, addProduct, updateProduct, deleteProduct, getOrders, updateOrderStatus, getWishlist, toggleWishlist, getCart, addToCart, removeFromCart, updateCartQuantity, clearCart, getDiscounts, addDiscount, updateDiscount, deleteDiscount, addLoyaltyPoints, trackOrder, login, signup, logout. Props convention: standard React components with destructured props, explicit fallback values, and Tailwind CSS utility classes.
